name: ccdc-digest-tools
description: Scan CCDC digest workbooks for ETL-incompatible characters and create a read-only Excel report.

interface.shortDescription: Find special characters in CCDC digest files.
interface.longDescription: Give Codex a digest-folder path to scan CCDC Excel workbooks and produce a read-only report with exact locations, Unicode details, original values, and values with rejected characters removed.
defaultPrompt: Scan my CCDC digest folder for special characters and create an Excel report.
